<ns0:svg xmlns:ns0="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1050" height="390" viewBox="0 0 1050 390" role="img" aria-labelledby="linkage_chromosomes-title linkage_chromosomes-desc">
	<ns0:title id="linkage_chromosomes-title">Cis and trans arrangements of linked w and m loci</ns0:title>
	<ns0:desc id="linkage_chromosomes-desc">Each panel shows a homologous pair schematically, with one rod per homolog. Cis has w m together and + + together; trans has w + and + m. Gene positions match between homologs. Colors track homolog identity, not dominance. No replication or crossover is depicted.</ns0:desc>
	
	<ns0:g font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, sans-serif">
		<ns0:g id="cis">
			<ns0:text x="215" y="47" font-size="34" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic">cis</ns0:text>
			<ns0:g id="cis-blue-homolog">
				<ns0:path data-shared-part="0" /><ns0:path d="M210 134 V174" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="210" y="120" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">w</ns0:text>
				<ns0:path d="M310 134 V174" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="310" y="120" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">m</ns0:text>
			</ns0:g>
			<ns0:g id="cis-orange-homolog">
				<ns0:path data-shared-part="1" /><ns0:path d="M210 250 V290" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="210" y="236" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">+</ns0:text>
				<ns0:path d="M310 250 V290" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="310" y="236" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">+</ns0:text>
			</ns0:g>
		</ns0:g>
		<ns0:g id="trans">
			<ns0:text x="785" y="47" font-size="34" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic">trans</ns0:text>
			<ns0:g id="trans-blue-homolog">
				<ns0:path data-shared-part="2" /><ns0:path d="M780 134 V174" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="780" y="120" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">w</ns0:text>
				<ns0:path d="M880 134 V174" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="880" y="120" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">+</ns0:text>
			</ns0:g>
			<ns0:g id="trans-orange-homolog">
				<ns0:path data-shared-part="3" /><ns0:path d="M780 250 V290" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="780" y="236" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">+</ns0:text>
				<ns0:path d="M880 250 V290" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
				<ns0:text x="880" y="236" font-size="30" fill="#253342" text-anchor="middle">m</ns0:text>
			</ns0:g>
		</ns0:g>
	</ns0:g>
</ns0:svg>
